scope: CLI help / parser only; no package construction, engine invocation, capture, provider or network request.

commands.stdout:
usage: world_art_preview_launcher.py [-h] [--godot GODOT]
                                     [--art-root ART_ROOT] [--pack PACK]
                                     [--design-revision DESIGN_REVISION]
                                     [--export-root EXPORT_ROOT]
                                     [--smoke-output SMOKE_OUTPUT]
                                     [--adapter-oracle]
                                     [--rendering-driver RENDERING_DRIVER]
                                     [--quit-after QUIT_AFTER] [--capture]
                                     [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                     [--collection NAME] [--shots SHOTS]
                                     [--feature ID[:VARIANT]] [--all-features]
                                     [--all-variants]
                                     [--resolution RESOLUTION]
                                     [--framing {fit,width,height,native}]
                                     [--zoom ZOOM] [--center CENTER]
                                     [--view VIEW] [--crop CROP]
                                     [--detail-zoom DETAIL_ZOOM]
                                     [--scale SCALE] [--stream-large]
                                     [--feature-scale FEATURE_SCALE]
                                     [--time TIME] [--no-glow] [--no-detail]
                                     [--no-background] [--allow-blank]
                                     [--display-driver DISPLAY_DRIVER]
                                     [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--verify-bundle DIR]
                                     [--compare-bundles BEFORE AFTER]

Run CyberSand World Art Preview with original shader source but no game
extensions.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --godot GODOT         Godot 4.7 executable; defaults to GODOT or godot on
                        PATH
  --art-root ART_ROOT   Directory containing all #454 collection folders
  --pack PACK           One specific pack.json (capture: repeatable; also
                        accepts a collection directory)
  --design-revision DESIGN_REVISION
                        Art revision label. Interactive: caller-provided.
                        Capture: optional, must match the checkout HEAD (the
                        real revision is detected from git)
  --export-root EXPORT_ROOT
                        Absolute destination for unique screenshot sessions
  --smoke-output SMOKE_OUTPUT
                        Absolute output directory (automated real GUI test)
  --adapter-oracle      Run source-pinned, headless RG8 adapter tests
  --rendering-driver RENDERING_DRIVER
                        opengl3 / opengl3_angle
  --quit-after QUIT_AFTER
                        Exit interactive window after this many rendered
                        frames (CI launch smoke)

unattended capture (--capture):
  --capture             render without any GUI interaction and write PNG +
                        manifest evidence
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        new or empty directory for the capture bundle (never
                        inside art sources)
  --collection NAME     with --art-root: capture only this collection
                        (repeatable); default all discovered
  --shots SHOTS         comma list of full,viewport,detail or 'none' (default
                        full,viewport,detail; features-only when
                        --feature/--all-features is given)
  --feature ID[:VARIANT]
                        also render this reusable feature (and authored
                        variant) (repeatable)
  --all-features        render every feature's base variant
  --all-variants        render every feature and every authored variant
  --resolution RESOLUTION
                        viewport/detail bound WIDTHxHEIGHT (default 1920x1080)
  --framing {fit,width,height,native}
                        viewport framing: whole map, fit-width, fit-height or
                        1 px/native cell
  --zoom ZOOM           viewport pixels per native cell (0.03..32)
  --center CENTER       with --zoom: view centre X,Y in native cells (default
                        map centre)
  --view VIEW           viewport fits this native-cell rectangle X,Y,W,H
  --crop CROP           detail crop in native cells X,Y,W,H (default centre
                        half of the map)
  --detail-zoom DETAIL_ZOOM
                        detail pixels per native cell (default largest integer
                        fitting --resolution)
  --scale SCALE         full-composition output scale 1..8 (default 2)
  --stream-large        explicit bounded RGB8 streamed full PNG above 50M up
                        to 100M pixels; never changes native World limits
  --feature-scale FEATURE_SCALE
                        feature output scale 1..8 (default 4)
  --time TIME           fixed shader presentation time in seconds (default
                        1.37, the viewer default)
  --no-glow             disable emission + glow
  --no-detail           disable structured material detail
  --no-background       disable background / decor
  --allow-blank         do not fail on a blank framebuffer
  --display-driver DISPLAY_DRIVER
                        optional Godot display driver (x11 / windows /
                        headless)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     seconds before the render is killed (default 1800)
  --verify-bundle DIR   re-verify a capture bundle and exit
  --compare-bundles BEFORE AFTER
                        compare two bundles captured with equivalent framing
                        and exit

usage: world_art_evaluation_package.py build [-h] --output OUTPUT --engine-dir
                                             ENGINE_DIR --engine-notices
                                             ENGINE_NOTICES --capture-evidence
                                             CAPTURE_EVIDENCE --source-sha
                                             SOURCE_SHA
                                             [--python-root PYTHON_ROOT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT
  --engine-dir ENGINE_DIR
  --engine-notices ENGINE_NOTICES
  --capture-evidence CAPTURE_EVIDENCE
  --source-sha SOURCE_SHA
  --python-root PYTHON_ROOT

usage: build_gallery.py [-h] --bundle BUNDLE [--output OUTPUT]

Generate an offline 15-scene / 120-feature gallery from verified *real Godot*
PNGs. The gallery never re-renders art or modifies the source. It is an index
into source-matched, independently verified PNG evidence. Invalid or
incomplete bundles are refused rather than displayed as accepted artwork.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --bundle BUNDLE
  --output OUTPUT  fresh index.html path (defaults to
                   BUNDLE/gallery/index.html)
